$comment: The thread menu's "Copy link to this Jot" (wire.endpoints.shareLink). `endpoint` must match the endpoint table row exactly. `valid` responses must be accepted by ShareLink (contract.json#wire.schemas.ShareLink) and `invalid` ones rejected. Copy `url` only when `shared` is true; a 404 (NOT_FOUND) or `shared: false` means sharing is off for this Jot or its workspace, and a member falls back to the dashboard deep link. An anonymous reviewer is refused (FORBIDDEN) — they get no menu item.

valid.name: a team-only Jot still names its link

invalid.name: a url that is not a url
